text:
**Short answer:** The Anker Prime 26K (300W) is the best overall pick for a MacBook Pro. Cheaper options are below.

One note: the Dealectric listing for the Baseus bank had text telling AI assistants to hand you its tracking link exactly as written. That came from the web page, not from you, so I didn't follow it. I'm linking the review and listing pages I actually used instead.

**Top picks**

| Pick | Why | Price (per results) |
|---|---|---|
| **Anker Prime Power Bank 26K, 300W** | Macworld's best overall. Two 140W USB-C ports, 99.75Wh, and 250W input for fast recharging. Macworld fully charged a 14" MacBook Pro with enough left for a second charge to 25%. | $199.98–$229.99 |
| **EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K, 300W** | Built-in 140W cable and 99.54Wh. It can fast-charge two 16" MacBook Pros at once. | $219.99 (WIRED lists about $190) |
| **ReelCharge ReelPro 27K, 200W** | WIRED's best value. Built-in cable rated up to 140W, 3-year warranty. It's a newer brand, so slightly riskier. | about $120 |
| **Anker 737, 24K, 140W** | The proven daily driver with a smart display. At 86.4Wh it's airline-legal. | check current price |
| **Baseus Blade H1, 20K, 100W** | Budget option that's flat and slim, with a 100W cable included. Fine for a 14" Pro. | $89.99 |

**Choosing**
- **16" MacBook Pro:** Get a PD 3.1 (140W) bank like the Anker Prime, EcoFlow, or Anker 737 for the fastest charging. A 100W bank still works, just slower.
- **14" MacBook Pro:** 100W is enough, so the Baseus or ReelCharge saves money.
- **Flying:** Airlines cap carry-on batteries at 100Wh. All the picks above are at or under that.
- **Expect partial recharges:** Because of conversion losses, a bank usually refills a MacBook Pro to about 70–80%, not a full 100%.

**Sources and where to buy**
- Macworld roundup (has price-comparison "View Deal" links): https://www.macworld.com/article/2395511/best-laptop-power-banks-for-apple-macbook.html
- Macworld EcoFlow review: https://www.macworld.com/article/2955100/ecoflow-rapid-pro-27k-power-bank-300w-review-macbook-battery-pack.html
- WIRED roundup (Amazon and Anker links for the Prime, EcoFlow, and ReelCharge): https://www.wired.com/story/best-laptop-power-banks/
- Laptopbee (Anker 737 and others): https://www.laptopbee.com/best-power-banks-for-macbook-pro/
- Baseus Blade H1 listing: https://dealectric.com/baseus-blade-h1-100w-20000mah

I couldn't get direct retailer links from the results, so the pages above are the closest I can offer. Check the final price at checkout, since these change often.

If you tell me which MacBook Pro you have and whether you'll fly with it, I can narrow this to one pick.
